title: Warm lentil salad with radishes and orange

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Lentils, oranges, mustard, vinegar, seeds and fresh vegetables are all plain larder and garden foods, with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Puy lentils, pumpkin seeds, watercress and radishes are everyday items at Tesco and similar supermarkets.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a saucepan, sieve, bowl and whisk, and the simplest techniques.

works.reason: 250g puy lentils with 200g radishes, watercress and oranges makes a sensible lunch for four, and the dressing ratio and seasoning are sound.

honest_times.reason: 25 minutes is ample for slicing the onion and radishes, peeling three oranges and chopping parsley, and the 25-minute lentil simmer matches the cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, nothing unlisted is used, and the names match their ids.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm salad suits mid-April, and 200g of sliced radishes is a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Lentils, seeds, greens, radishes and orange make a filling, balanced lunch of real food.
